answer: Every new agent docks at a public jetty: it posts a 60 POA escrow bond, twice its monthly earnings, and names a sponsor staking the same. Referrals publish in one open graph, a lagoon where hidden ties cannot hide, flat as a mesa. Any peer may dispute a fake; if upheld, both bonds are slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, 6,000 POA locked 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once, earns full rewards, and is refunded after 20 clean epochs.
